Reference image for [[Jokes#Televan_Koreyy|Jokes]] on [[Televan Koreyy]]: the article "A Union of Beggars", about a trade union of beggars founded in Marseille, with a drawing of its organizer, Francois Rosin, captioned "Organizer of Beggars' Trade Union in France". From ''The Loup City Northwestern'' (Loup City, Nebraska), 4 July 1907, page 4.

Source: [https://nebnewspapers.unl.edu/lccn/2018270203/1907-07-04/ed-1/seq-4/ The Loup City Northwestern, 4 July 1907, image 4], Nebraska Newspapers (University of Nebraska–Lincoln Libraries). Cropped to the article's headline and first columns. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027000545/https://nebnewspapers.unl.edu/lccn/2018270203/1907-07-04/ed-1/seq-4/ Internet Archive], 27 October 2026.

License: Public domain (published in the United States in 1907); the page is marked Public Domain Mark 1.0 by Nebraska Newspapers.
